title: A/R Collection: changing the date or a filter collapses every group
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has open invoices at both locations, some 31 to 60 days past due, on today's and yesterday's date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-18 Collapse Me.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with every group expanded (Expand all).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  2. Click the top-left chevron button to expand every group.
  3. In the Customer filter, tick {Customer-A}.
  4. Click the top-left chevron button to expand every group.
  5. In the Past due filter, tick "31-60 days".
  6. Click the top-left chevron button to expand every group.
  7. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report reloads for yesterday with every group collapsed.
  • Step 2: every group expands.
  • Step 3: only {Customer-A}'s rows remain and every group is collapsed.
  • Step 4: every group expands.
  • Step 5: every group collapses.
  • Step 6: every group expands.
  • Step 7: every group collapses.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-N1: “Changing the as-of date, the customer or vendor filter, the Past due filter or the Location filter collapses every group, as changing the date or filter does today.”
